sections.heading: CHAPTER 1: THE CLUB
sections.content:
1.1 The Club shall be known as the Rebel Hounds Motorcycle Club.

1.2 The Club is a family-oriented organization. All members are expected to uphold the values of loyalty, respect, and brotherhood.

1.3 The Club claims and defends the right to bear the 1%er Diamond.

1.4 These Bylaws govern the internal affairs of the Club and shall take precedence over any conflicting rules or directives.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 2: CHAPTER REPORTING
sections.content:
2.1 Each Chapter shall maintain regular communication with the Club President or designated officer.

2.2 Chapter Presidents are responsible for reporting membership changes, events, and any issues to the Club leadership.

2.3 Chapter meetings shall be held at least once per month.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 3: OFFICER DUTIES AND ELECTIONS
sections.content:
3.1 Club Officers shall include: President, Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer, Sergeant at Arms, and Road Captain.

3.2 Officers shall be elected by a majority vote of Patch Holders.

3.3 Officer terms shall be for a period determined by the Club.

3.4 Any Patch Holder may nominate themselves or another Patch Holder for an officer position.

3.5 Officers may be removed by a two-thirds vote of the Patch Holders.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 4: PATCH HOLDER RESPONSIBILITIES
sections.content:
4.1 Patch Holders are expected to attend all Club meetings and events unless excused.

4.2 Patch Holders must maintain the standards and reputation of the Club at all times.

4.3 Patch Holders shall not engage in activities that bring disrepute to the Club.

4.4 Each Patch Holder is responsible for mentoring Prospects assigned to them.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 5: PROSPECTS
sections.content:
5.1 Prospects shall be sponsored by at least one Patch Holder.

5.2 The Prospect period shall last a minimum of three (3) months.

5.3 Prospects must demonstrate their commitment to the Club through attendance, participation, and adherence to Club rules.

5.4 Patch Holders will vote on a Prospect's admission to full membership by majority vote.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 6: DISCORD SERVERS
sections.content:
6.1 The Club shall maintain official Discord servers for communication and coordination.

6.2 All members are expected to be active on the official Discord servers.

6.3 Conduct on Discord servers shall reflect the values and standards of the Club.

6.4 The Club reserves the right to moderate and manage Discord server access.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 7: OUTSIDE ORGANIZATIONS
sections.content:
7.1 Members shall not hold membership in competing motorcycle clubs without prior approval from the Club President.

7.2 The Club may form alliances or partnerships with other organizations by vote of the Patch Holders.

7.3 Members representing the Club at outside events must have authorization from Club leadership.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 8: RUNS AND EVENTS
sections.content:
8.1 Club runs and events shall be organized by the Road Captain or designated officer.

8.2 Attendance at official Club runs is expected of all Patch Holders.

8.3 Safety protocols must be followed during all Club runs.

8.4 The Club may host public events with approval from the Club President.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 9: INVESTMENTS AND LOANS
sections.content:
9.1 The Club may make investments or loans by majority vote of the Patch Holders.

9.2 All financial transactions must be documented by the Treasurer.

9.3 Individual members may not borrow Club funds without approval from the Club President and Treasurer.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 10: FINANCES
sections.content:
10.1 The Club Treasurer shall maintain accurate records of all income and expenses.

10.2 Dues shall be set by vote of the Patch Holders.

10.3 Financial reports shall be presented to the Club at regular intervals.

10.4 The Club bank account shall require dual authorization for transactions above the amount set by the Club.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 11: REMOVAL AND RESIGNATION
sections.content:
11.1 A member may be removed from the Club by a two-thirds vote of the Patch Holders.

11.2 Grounds for removal include but are not limited to: violation of Club Bylaws, conduct unbecoming a Patch Holder, and failure to meet membership obligations.

11.3 A member wishing to resign must notify the Club President in writing.

11.4 All Club property and patches must be returned upon resignation or removal.

sections.heading: CHAPTER 12: AMENDMENTS
sections.content:
12.1 These Bylaws may be amended by a two-thirds vote of the Patch Holders.

12.2 Proposed amendments must be submitted in writing to the Club President at least seven (7) days before the vote.

12.3 All amendments shall take effect immediately upon passage unless otherwise specified.
